titles.title: Quake1
titles.engine_and_build:
id Quake retail tree, Games-Library\Quake1. All md5s re-hashed 04:00 EDT; unchanged since the earlier pass.
- GLQUAKE.EXE 435,712 B md5 bcf40493: id GLQuake, the same file as VOODOO\GLQUAKE.EXE.
- WINQUAKE.EXE 553,472 B md5 0b62b82d: SciTech MGL software build.
- QUAKE.EXE 409,600 B md5 e3e7fcc9: the DOS build. Software only, with VGA 320x200, Mode X and VESA 2.0 modes; CWSDPMI.EXE beside it.
- VOODOO\OPENGL32.DLL 142,848 B md5 332ee07b: the Quake II 3.20 3dfx MiniGL (imports glide2x _grSstWinOpen@28).

No DOS Glide build of Quake is in the library or on the share. D:\GAMES\QUAKEPRP on .243 (DOSFILL QUAKEPRP.ZIP) is another software DOS QUAKE.EXE (396,288 B). So .243's only Voodoo 2 path is Win98 GLQuake over the MiniGL, not DOS Quake plus SST_SCREENREFRESH.

Launchers (library changed 2026-09-29 01:13):
- Play Quake.bat: GLQuake, min_os win2k.
- Play Quake - Software.bat: WinQuake, min_os win2k.
- Play Quake - Voodoo.bat: requires the glide capability.
- Play Quake - DOS.bat: new, max_os win9x.

titles.resolution_per_box:
Play Quake.bat calls FLEETRES -cap 1280 960, then runs GLQUAKE.EXE -width %FR_W43% -height %FR_H43% -bpp 32. Values below were recomputed with the shipped gameres.h gr_decide (the port of fleetres.c) on the 04:01 GAMERES lists (static/sim-output-0401.txt).

- .123, .145, .240 and .195: 800x600x32, COMPUTED.
  - The cap branch (fleetres.c:787-799) keeps 16:9 and picks 1280x720, which all four list.
  - The 4:3 ladder inside 720 lines (fleetres.c:806-816) then stops at 800x600.
  - So the launcher comment's '1280x960 measured on .145' is not what the current code asks for.
  - Real fleetres.cmd files (uncapped runs) confirm the LCD branch on all four.
- .124: 1280x960x32 (retrogl.log shows GLQUAKE.EXE at res 17 = 1280x960).
- .243 Voodoo: 640x480x16, a launcher constant. The MiniGL maps a height of 480 or less (cmp 0x1e0 at 0x1000b9b2) to GR_RESOLUTION_640x480.
- .243 DOS: 320x200, VGA mode 13h. DOS Quake defaults to _vid_default_mode 0, and the older C:\Games tree's ID1\config.cfg also says 0.
- WinQuake picks its own mode; no resolution is forced.
titles.refresh_control:
None in any Quake binary. A case-insensitive strings -a sweep finds only vid_mode, r_norefresh, timerefresh and -current (static/strings-refresh-ci.txt).

- GLQUAKE.EXE VID_SetFullDIBMode:
  - 0x41448c: dmFields=0x1c0000 (BITSPERPEL|PELSWIDTH|PELSHEIGHT, no DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY 0x400000).
  - 0x414485: push 4 (CDS_FULLSCREEN).
  - 0x4144d0: call [0xd58608] = USER32!ChangeDisplaySettingsA.
  - The mode-list probes at 0x415891 and 0x415a4d are also 0x1c0000.
  - A whole-binary scan found no DEVMODE dmFields store carrying 0x400000 (static/dmfields-scan.txt, static/cds-sites-objdump.txt).
- -current (0x414470-0x414480, leavecurrentmode at [0x8094a0]) skips the CDS and keeps the desktop's mode and rate.
- WinQuake: its CDS sites (0x40c869-0x40da72) are all 0x1c0000; its MGL/DirectDraw modes carry no rate.
- DOS QUAKE.EXE: VGA, Mode X and VESA 2.0 only; nothing to set a rate with.
- Voodoo (.243):
  - The MiniGL passes refresh 0 = GR_REFRESH_60Hz at all three _grSstWinOpen@28 calls (0x100034c5, 0x1000b9f6, 0x1000ba81).
  - Glide 2.56 (cvg) replaces that only with SSTV2_SCREENREFRESH or SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480.
  - Only 75, 85 or 120 are accepted; anything else becomes 60 (glide2x/cvg/init/video.c:1062-1140, sst1InitConvertRefreshRate :1234).
  - Lookup order: process env, then HKLM Software\3Dfx Interactive\Voodoo2\Glide, then ...\Voodoo2, then voodoo2.ini (parse.c:1094).
  - The Voodoo 2's 640x480 timings are 60 Hz/31.5 kHz, 75/37.6, 85/43.3 and 120/61.2 (sst1init.h; static/voodoo2-timings.txt).
- .124:
  - The ICD's fxBestRefresh (retro3dfx-gl fxapi.c:406) asks for the highest EnumDisplaySettings rate at W x H.
  - Our h5 Glide hwcInitVideo (minihwc.c:4675) then REPLACES that rate with FX_GLIDE_REFRESH, looked up by hwcGetenv (minihwc.c:9547): getenv, then HKCU, then HKLM SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide.
  - getRegPath (minihwc.c:1404) hard-codes that 3dfxvs\Device0 path on 2k/XP whenever the key exists.
  - The rate then goes to IDirectDraw2_SetDisplayMode(w,h,bpp,refresh), with a retry at rate 0 (win_mode.c).

titles.gap:
- .123, .145, .240: 60 against 75, i.e. -15 Hz (likely).
- .124: 75 against 85, i.e. -10 Hz (likely). The cause is a stale 3dfx registry value, not the game.
- .195: none.
- .243 Voodoo: 60 against a tube ceiling nobody has proven; 75 is plausible.
- .243 DOS: none.
titles.fix:
No per-title knob exists, so Quake needs the generic mechanisms.

1. XP LCD boxes (.123 .145 .240), GLQuake:
   - Needs phase 1 of the parent mechanism first. It adds FR_HZ43 (gr_target_hz at FR_W43 x FR_H43, EDID-capped, 0 = leave the rate alone). It lives in worktree .claude/worktrees/refresh-mech (FLEETRES.phase1.exe md5 df610a98); the staged FLEETRES.EXE (bb180f3b) still emits only FR_HZ.
   - Then Play Quake.bat starts the hardened REFRESHKEEP.EXE hidden, via wscript hidden.vbs as scripts/game-refresh/deploy_game_refresh.py does: '%FR_HZ43% GLQUAKE.EXE 14400'.
   - Only when FR_HZ43 is not 0 and the box's GL is not Glide-backed (today: FR_UE1DEV is not GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice).
   - Stage REFRESHKEEP.EXE into the tree through stage-fleetres.py, the way FLEETRES.EXE is staged. It is on no box today: at 04:05, .123, .145 and .240 had no refreshkeep*, no launch\ and no hidden.vbs.
   - If the 1080p workflow changes what this launcher passes, the rate must follow: FR_HZW for FR_W/FR_H, or nothing for -current (which makes no mode change).
2. .124:
   - In Play Quake.bat: 'if not defined FX_GLIDE_REFRESH', and FR_HZ43 is not 0, 'set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZ43%' (85) before start.
   - The process env beats the HKLM 75 in hwcGetenv, and 'if not defined' leaves a V5 bench harness's pinned value alone.
   - Never run refreshkeep there.
   - Clearing the HKLM value would fix every Glide title on .124 at once, but it is a 3dfx-driver setting that the V5 lane owns. Only on explicit chat approval, and never with REGDELETE, which erases the whole glide key.
3. .243 Voodoo:
   - Play Quake - Voodoo.bat: 'if exist VOODOO2HZ.BAT call VOODOO2HZ.BAT' before start /w.
   - The fragment holds 'set SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480=<75|85|120>'. Exactly one writer (the agent's GAMERES pass, which runs on 9x) writes it, and only from an operator-declared tube ceiling, e.g. a per-box HKLM\Software\RetroAgent value following the ResCapW/ResCapH pattern.
   - No declared ceiling means no fragment, and 60 stays.
   - Phase 1's no-EDID rule (the persisted rate at a size no bigger than the desktop, where that timing exists) would allow 75 if Glide's own timing table counts as the list. That is the operator's call.
   - Do not use FLEETRES -cmd output for this: it emits set "VAR=val", which COMMAND.COM misreads.
4. .243 DOS and .195: nothing to do.
5. WinQuake: leave it. It uses DirectDraw-exclusive modes, and refreshkeep must not run on DDraw titles.
6. Per-title alternative: rebuild GLQuake from id's GPL source with a -freq switch. Protocol 15 is unchanged, and the host server is DarkPlaces with sv_protocolname QUAKE. No Quake 1 source port is on the share: a case-insensitive find over Games, Game Updates, Patches and Utility found none; the only port there is Quake3e, which is Quake III.
titles.fix_risk:
- refreshkeep:
  - One extra monitor re-sync about 1 s after GLQuake's own CDS.
  - Unmeasured on Catalyst 8.970/8.593 and ForceWare 340.52; measured only on ForceWare 71.89 (Quake II held at 100 Hz on .143).
  - Applies with flags 0, so a hard crash leaves the desktop at 800x600@75 until the next mode set.
  - The hardened build stops after 3 re-applies in 60 s.
- LCDs: 75 Hz on the analog P2312H/E2414H and the DVI E2313H is only what EDID and the driver claim. If a scaler frame-drops to 60, a 75 Hz input judders. Check it on the screen.
- .124: 85 Hz at 1280x960 is driver-listed and EDID-capped. Moving 75 to 85 changes V5 benchmark comparability, which is why the 'if not defined' guard is there. Coordinate with the V5 lane.
- .243:
  - A wrong rate shows 'out of range' on an unwatched CRT whose recovery needs a person; hence the operator gate.
  - COMMAND.COM upper-cases env names (SSTV2_REFRESH_640X480). Glide's MSVC getenv and registry fallback should match case-insensitively; verify it.
  - Unverified: that START passes the DOS box's environment to a Win32 child on Win98.
  - 'Out of environment space' drops the set silently.
titles.verify_on_hw:
Test fullscreen, at the menu, one box at a time. Pace CRT switches at least 5 s apart. Only after the 1080p workflow releases the LCD screens.
- XP and Win7: DISPLAYCFG get (ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS) while GLQuake runs, plus the monitor OSD. The same read settles 800x600 against 1280x960. On .145, cross-check with WINLIST, since DISPLAYCFG once read its inactive Intel HD.
- .124, together with the V5 lane:
  - DISPLAYCFG get during play.
  - retrogl.log 'fxBestRefresh ... -> GR_REFRESH enum N' shows the request.
  - One run with FX_GLIDE_TRACE=1 writes C:\vcr\glidelab\glidetrace.log. Its 'hwcInitVideo: setVideoMode (reg=refresh ...)' line gives the Hz Glide really used: reg=0000004b is 75, 00000055 is 85.
  - vcrctl dump shows each DrvEnablePDEV frequency.
- .243 Voodoo: one run with SSTV2_INITDEBUG_FILE=C:\V2INIT.TXT, which on its own enables logging (print.c:57; the string is in the kit DLL). DOWNLOAD the file, never EXEC. Read 'sst1InitVideo() Setting up video for resolution (640, 480), Refresh:NN Hz', and check the OSD.
- .243 DOS: OSD only; DISPLAYCFG reads 0 on Win9x.
titles.verifier_notes:
Re-verified fresh between 04:00 and 04:06 EDT, read-only: GAMERES, DISPLAYCFG get, DIRLIST, REGREAD and DOWNLOAD. Evidence: .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-quake-era-v2/.
- Confirmed: all md5s; every GLQuake CDS site (objdump plus the dmFields scan); the MiniGL's ref 0; the cvg SSTV2 logic; .124's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 still present; no SSTV2 refresh anywhere on .243 (registry, VOODOO2.VAR, AUTOEXEC.BAT).

Changed since the earlier pass:
- The library split Quake at 01:13: Win9x now gets Voodoo + DOS, and the GL and Software shortcuts are NT-only.
- .243 deploys to E:\GAMES, so C:\Games\Quake1 is stale.
- .240's EDID reads again: DELL E2313H, digital; the active adapter is a Radeon X1600.

Observation: .243's C:\WINDOWS\Desktop held only Retro Agent.lnk and Retro Chat.lnk at 08:02 box-UTC, i.e. no game shortcuts at that moment.

Side notes for other workflows:
- 1080p: GLQuake's 'Specified video mode not available' at 1920x1080 comes from its 30-entry mode list (cmp 0x1e at 0x415881), not from a compiled 4:3 table. -current renders at the desktop mode with no CDS. Both are untested at 1080p.
- gameres.h's NOTE ON REFRESH says raising the persisted desktop rate reaches engines with no refresh setting. The 2026-08-25 measurement contradicts it.

.124's agent answered at 04:01, then gave 'no route' at 04:05 and 'refused' at 04:06. Not touched; it is the V5 lane's box.

titles.title: Quake2Complete
titles.engine_and_build:
id Quake II 3.20 (3.20_Changes.txt):
- quake2.exe 362,496 B md5 57dd2cf4 (imports no ChangeDisplaySettings; the mode set is in the ref DLL).
- ref_gl.dll 234,496 B md5 b6d33427.
- ref_soft.dll md5 203dc879.
- 3dfxgl.dll md5 332ee07b, the same MiniGL as Quake1's VOODOO\OPENGL32.DLL.
- pvrgl.dll 227,328 B.
- Mod directories: xatrix, rogue, ctf.

baseq2\autoexec.cfg sets vid_ref gl, gl_driver opengl32 and gl_mode 6, then exec's fleetres.cfg.
titles.on_boxes:
.123, .124, .145, .195 and .240 (DIRLIST 04:01).
- Not on .243: min_os win2k, and .243 gets Quake2Win9x instead.
- Four launchers: Quake II, The Reckoning, Ground Zero, ThreeWave CTF. All are cmd.exe dialect. Each runs FLEETRES with no cap, writes <mod>\fleetres.cfg (gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE%, vid_fullscreen 1), and starts quake2.exe +set gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% [+set game X].
- Renderer: ref_gl through opengl32.
  - Vendor ICD on .123, .145, .195 and .240. The compat DB has it verified on .123, .145 (ForceWare 340.52), .240 and .195 (listed there as .246).
  - .124: retroicd.dll over the GAME-LOCAL C:\Games\Quake2Complete\glide3x.dll (retrogl.log), i.e. Glide on the V5 6000.
titles.resolution_per_box:
gl_mode 8 = 1280x960 on all five boxes.
- Sources: GAMERES q2mode 8 at 04:01; FR_Q2MODE=8 in the real fleetres.cmd of .123, .145, .195 and .240; on .124, baseq2\fleetres.cfg 'set gl_mode "8"' and retrogl.log res 17.
- The mode is set twice per launch:
  - The first set uses the early +set, before autoexec runs.
  - autoexec's gl_mode 6 and then fleetres.cfg's 8 mark gl_mode modified, which triggers a vid_restart.
  - retrogl.log shows two GL contexts per quake2.exe pid on .124.
titles.refresh_control:
None; confirmed.
- ref_gl GLimp_SetMode:
  - 0x1000de73: dmFields 0x180000 (PELSWIDTH|PELSHEIGHT).
  - 0x1000de9a: 0x1c0000 when gl_bitdepth is not 0.
  - 0x1000def7: ebx = [0x1002714c] = USER32!ChangeDisplaySettingsA.
  - 0x1000df04: push 4 (CDS_FULLSCREEN).
  - 0x1000df07: call ebx.
- The retry block (0x1000df98/0x1000dfd2) and the calls at 0x1000e0a1/0x1000e1bb carry no rate either.
- No DEVMODE store with 0x400000 exists in ref_gl, ref_soft or quake2.exe (static/dmfields-scan.txt).
- Strings: gl_mode, gl_bitdepth, gl_swapinterval, gl_ext_swapinterval, r_norefresh, vid_ref, and SST_GAMMA/SSTV2_GAMMA (a gamma putenv only).
- ref_soft uses DirectDraw with no rate.
- .124: the ICD's fxBestRefresh, then Glide's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH override (see Quake1).
titles.set_today:
No refresh is set.
- fleetres.cfg in baseq2, xatrix, rogue and ctf is written both by the launcher and by the GAMERES idtech2 body (gameres.h rows 702-705; the body is gl_mode %Q2MODE% plus vid_fullscreen 1). Neither has a rate line, and Quake II could not read one anyway.
- FRHZ is unused.
- .124: the HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 also applies to the game-local glide3x.dll, which reads the same key.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .145, .240: most likely 60, on both mode sets.
  - The CDS carries no rate.
  - XP measured 60 for this exact title twice on ForceWare 71.89: .124 on 2026-08-25, and .143, where it ran 60.0 fps vsync-capped against 100.0 fps under refreshkeep 100.
  - UNMEASURED on Catalyst 8.970/8.593 and ForceWare 340.52.
- .195: 60.
- .124: most likely 75.
  - retrogl.log shows quake2.exe 'fxBestRefresh: 1280x960 max 85 Hz -> GR_REFRESH enum 7' on every context.
  - The registry's 75 wins inside Glide.
  - Unmeasured in game.
titles.fix:
1. XP LCD boxes: a hidden REFRESHKEEP.EXE '%FR_HZQ2% quake2.exe 14400' in all four launchers, with the same gates as Quake1 (rate not 0, GL not Glide-backed).
   - FR_HZQ2 is phase-1 gr_target_hz at the gl_mode index size; here it equals FR_HZ43.
   - It re-applies after each of the game's two mode sets, within the 3-per-60-s budget.
2. .124: in all four launchers, 'if not defined FX_GLIDE_REFRESH', set it to %FR_HZQ2% (85).
3. Per-title alternative, the cleanest long-term fix:
   - Rebuild ref_gl.dll from id's GPL Quake II 3.21 source with SoF's gl_displayrefresh semantics: DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY only when the value is non-zero.
   - Pass '+set gl_displayrefresh %FR_HZQ2%' on the command line, like gl_mode.
   - API_VERSION is unchanged, so quake2.exe 3.20 and the :27910 server are untouched.
4. Do NOT add a rate line to the idtech2 GAMERES body or to fleetres.cfg:
   - Quake II has no cvar to read it.
   - That body is shared by 7 files across 3 titles, so a mismatch trips test_a_shared_cfg_is_written_identically_by_both_writers.
   - fleetres.cfg is exec'd after the first mode set anyway.
5. No Quake II port (Yamagi, Q2PRO, R1Q2, KMQuake2) is on the share (case-insensitive search).
6. .195: nothing to do.
titles.fix_risk:
- Same as Quake1, twice per launch, because the game itself sets the mode twice.
- A higher refresh also raises Quake II's vsync frame cap (gl_swapinterval defaults to 1; .143 ran 60.0 fps at 60 Hz and 100.0 at 100 Hz). Any benchmark taken through these launchers moves.
- A rebuilt ref_gl is new code in every launch (the vid_restart path, the 3dfx gamma putenv, extension handling). It needs the full GL test pass on every GPU family, including .124's Glide ICD.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- DISPLAYCFG get and the OSD at the menu, after both mode sets have settled.
- +set logfile 2 gives baseq2\qconsole.log '...setting mode 8: 1280 960 FS' and '...calling CDS: ok'. That confirms the resolution only; Quake II never logs the rate.
- refreshkeep.log records every re-apply.
- .124: retrogl.log, a FX_GLIDE_TRACE glidetrace 'setVideoMode (reg=refresh ...)' line, and the vcrctl log, together with the V5 lane.
titles.verifier_notes:
- md5s unchanged at 04:00. The ref_gl CDS sites were re-disassembled (static/cds-sites-objdump.txt).
- quake2.exe imports no ChangeDisplaySettings. Its 'or ebx,0x400000' is not a DEVMODE store.
- .145's ForceWare 340.52 runs this ref_gl (compat DB +V2), unlike SiN's.
- The staged baseq2\autoexec.cfg comment says autoexec runs BEFORE VID_Init. .243's qconsole.log shows the opposite: 'setting mode' comes before 'execing autoexec.cfg'.

titles.title: Quake2Win9x
titles.engine_and_build:
The Quake II 3.20 base game for Win9x.
- quake2.exe, ref_gl.dll, ref_soft.dll and 3dfxgl.dll are byte-identical to Quake2Complete's (md5 57dd2cf4, b6d33427, 203dc879, 332ee07b).
- COMMAND.COM launchers, plus DESKFIX9.EXE.
titles.on_boxes:
Only .243 (max_os win9x).
- The live tree is E:\GAMES\Quake2Win9x (GamesDir=E:\GAMES). A stale C:\Games\Quake2Win9x still holds the last runs' logs.
- 'Play Quake II - Voodoo.bat' writes baseq2\fleetres.cfg (vid_ref gl, gl_driver 3dfxgl, gl_mode 3, vid_fullscreen 1). That runs ref_gl over the 3dfx MiniGL and C:\WINDOWS\SYSTEM\GLIDE2X.DLL (kit 3.02.02, Glide 2.56) on the pass-through Voodoo 2. The box's qconsole.log shows '...setting mode 3: 640 480 FS' and GL_RENDERER '3Dfx Interactive Voodoo(tm)'.
- 'Play Quake II.bat' runs ref_soft (sw_mode 3) through DirectDraw on the Cirrus 5436. The same log shows '...setting exclusive mode: ok' and '...setting linear mode: ok'.
- A bench harness also runs this title there: glquake_win9x_bench.py, with bench.cfg dated 2026-09-28.
titles.resolution_per_box:
.243 only.
- Voodoo: 640x480x16. gl_mode 3 is a launcher constant, and the MiniGL maps it to GR_RESOLUTION_640x480.

titles.title: HexenII
titles.engine_and_build:
Raven Hexen II retail 1.03, derived from GLQuake:
- glh2.exe 530,944 B md5 c450ea8a, the same file as VOODOO\GLH2.EXE.
- h2.exe 674,816 B md5 7ad8abed: the software build (MGL/WinDirect).
- VOODOO\OPENGL32.DLL md5 332ee07b: the Quake II 3.20 MiniGL.
- Glroot-3dfx-minigl\opengl32.dll 126,464 B md5 914847f5: the 1997 MiniGL, parked and not on the load path.
titles.on_boxes:
.123, .124, .145, .195 and .240 (DIRLIST 04:01), plus .243. On .243 the live tree is E:\GAMES\HexenII (requires.json 2906 B, updated 05:14 box-UTC); a stale copy remains in C:\Games.
- NT boxes: Play, Host LAN and Join LAN run glh2.exe on the system ICD; Software runs h2.exe.
- .124: glh2 goes through retroicd and system32 glide3x to the V5 6000. The Voodoo shortcut CALLs Play Hexen II.bat.
- .243: only 'Play Hexen II - Voodoo.bat' (VOODOO\GLH2.EXE plus the MiniGL over Glide 2.56 on the Voodoo 2). Since 01:14 every other launcher is min_os win2k.
titles.resolution_per_box:
The launchers call FLEETRES -cap 1024 768, then glh2 -width %FR_W% -height %FR_H%, with no -bpp. Computed with gameres.h gr_decide on the 04:01 lists:
- .123: 848x480. The cap keeps 16:9, and the box lists 848x480.
- .240: 848x480, same reason.
- .145: 1024x768. It lists no 16:9 mode 1024 wide or narrower, so the cap itself is used.
- .195: 1024x768, same reason.
- .124: 1024x768 (retrogl.log: glh2 at res 12).
- .243 Voodoo: 640x480x16, a launcher constant. An older C:\Games log records an earlier 800x600x16 Voodoo run.

Unmeasured: whether glh2's 30-entry mode list (cmp ecx,0x1e at 0x4308e2) holds 848x480 on the ATI boxes. If it does not, glh2 stops with 'Specified video mode not available' and the LAN host never opens UDP 26900. That is the resolution workflow's call. With no -bpp, the GLQuake-family search may pick 16 bpp.
titles.refresh_control:
None; confirmed.
- Strings: only vid_mode, r_norefresh and -current.
- glh2 VID_SetFullDIBMode:
  - 0x42f565: dmFields 0x1c0000.
  - 0x42f59d: push 4 (CDS_FULLSCREEN).
  - 0x42f5b8: call [0xdf76c8] = USER32!ChangeDisplaySettingsA.
  - The mode probes at 0x4308f1 and 0x430ad0 are also 0x1c0000.
  - -current skips the CDS, as in GLQuake.
- h2.exe: its CDS sites (0x415e99-0x417052) are all 0x1c0000, plus MGL/DirectDraw modes.
- Voodoo: the MiniGL's ref 0 plus SSTV2_* (see Quake2Win9x).
- .124: fxBestRefresh, then the FX_GLIDE_REFRESH override.
titles.set_today:

- There is no GAMERES rule.

- The Voodoo launcher passes 640x480x16 and no SSTV2_* variable.
- .124: the HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 applies.

- .123, .145, .240: most likely 60; unmeasured.
- .195: 60.

  - retrogl.log: glh2 'fxBestRefresh: 1024x768 max 85 Hz -> GR_REFRESH enum 7'.
  - The registry's 75 wins inside Glide.

- .243 Voodoo: 60. The code path is certain; unmeasured on screen.

titles.fix:
Same as Quake1, but with FR_HZW, because these launchers pass FR_W/FR_H.
- XP LCD boxes: a hidden REFRESHKEEP.EXE '%FR_HZW% glh2.exe' in Play, Host and Join, with the Quake1 gates.
- .124: in Play Hexen II.bat (the .124 Voodoo shortcut goes through it too), 'if not defined FX_GLIDE_REFRESH', set it to %FR_HZW% (85).

- If glh2 runs at 16 bpp, refreshkeep only forces a rate the driver lists at 16 bpp. That is safe but may do nothing.

titles.title: SiNGold
titles.engine_and_build:
Ritual SiN 1.11 (the official patch; an id Tech 2 derivative), plus Wages of SiN in 2015\.
- sin.exe 667,648 B md5 8d320d7f (imports no ChangeDisplaySettings).
- ref_gl.dll 278,528 B md5 050bdfd6. ref_soft.dll is deliberately the same bytes.
- ref_gl_amd.dll 283,648 B md5 4dd5b116.
- ref_soft_real.dll 262,144 B md5 d5320ca5: the genuine software renderer.
- 3dfxgl.dll 137,728 B md5 226edb25: unused, since gl_driver is opengl32.
titles.on_boxes:
.123, .124, .145, .195 and .240 (DIRLIST 04:01).
- Not on .243: disk_mb is 1040, and neither E:\GAMES nor C:\Games holds it.
- GL goes through opengl32: the vendor ICD on .123, .240 and .195; on .124, retroicd over system32 glide3x (retrogl.log: sin.exe at 1280x960).
- .145: every GL context kills sin.exe, so the working shortcut there is 'Play SiN - software renderer.bat' (ref_soft_real, DirectDraw exclusive).
titles.resolution_per_box:
- GL launchers: gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% = 8 = 1280x960 on .123, .240, .195 and .124. The mode is set at least twice per start (the ref_soft to ref_gl hand-off documented in base\autoexec.cfg).
- .145 software: 1024x768 (sw_mode 6).
  - The launcher's '+set sw_mode %FR_Q2MODE%' is an early command.
  - base\autoexec.cfg line 107, 'set sw_mode "6"', runs later, and fleetres.cfg carries only gl_mode, so 6 wins.
  - This matches the launcher's recorded 'mode 6: 1024 768 FS' on .145.
titles.refresh_control:
None; confirmed.
- ref_gl GLimp_SetMode:
  - 0x12017c2d: dmFields 0x180000; 0x12017c54: 0x1c0000.
  - 0x12017cb1: ebx = [0x1202f120] = USER32!ChangeDisplaySettingsA.
  - 0x12017cbe: push 4; 0x12017cc1: call ebx.
  - The retry sites (0x12017d62/0x12017d9c) carry no rate.
- ref_gl_amd is the same code at 0x1201692d/0x12016954, with the call at 0x120169c1.
- ref_soft_real uses DirectDraw with no rate; it imports no CDS.
- sin.exe's 'Setting frequency from' is a script-effect parameter, not a display setting. Its other strings are gl_mode, sw_mode, vid_ref and gl_swapinterval.
titles.set_today:
No refresh is set.
- fleetres.cfg in base and 2015 comes from the launcher echo and the GAMERES idtech2 body (rows 706-707): gl_mode and vid_fullscreen only.
- The software launcher passes only +set sw_mode.
- FRHZ is unused.
- .124: the HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 applies.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .240: most likely 60 on every mode set; unmeasured.
- .145: most likely 60, since DirectDraw with rate 0 gets the driver default; unmeasured.
- .195: 60.
- .124: most likely 75.
  - retrogl.log: sin.exe 'fxBestRefresh: 1280x960 max 85 Hz -> enum 7'.
  - The registry's 75 wins inside Glide.
  - Unmeasured in game.
titles.fix:
- GL launchers (Play SiN Gold.bat, Play Wages of SiN.bat) on the XP LCD boxes: a hidden REFRESHKEEP.EXE '%FR_HZQ2% sin.exe', with the Quake1 gates and a time limit longer than SiN's start, which can exceed 60 s.
- .124: 'if not defined FX_GLIDE_REFRESH', set it to %FR_HZQ2% (85).
- .145 software launcher: it is DirectDraw exclusive, so refreshkeep must not run there (device loss and mode ping-pong).
  - The only OS lever is DirectDraw ForceRefreshRate (HKLM\Software\Microsoft\DirectDraw): one rate for every DDraw app, which would have to be set and cleared around each launch.
  - Not recommended without a measurement.
  - Either accept 60 there, or fix .145's GL crash (likely the long extension string on 340.52) so the box can use the GL launcher.
- No per-title knob exists: only SiN's game code was ever released, not the engine, and no port is on the share.
- .195: nothing to do.
titles.fix_risk:
- Same as Quake1.
- SiN sets the mode several times during a start that can exceed 60 s. That may use up refreshkeep's 3-per-60-s budget before the final mode lands; it then stops and prints its STOPPING banner. Measure the mode sequence first, then size the delay and window.
- On .145, an external CDS under a DirectDraw exclusive surface risks surface loss.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- DISPLAYCFG get only after at least 100 s at the menu; earlier readings catch intermediate modes. Plus the OSD.
- +set logfile 2 gives the mode lines.
- refreshkeep.log records each re-apply.
- .124: retrogl.log, glidetrace and vcrctl.
titles.verifier_notes:
- Confirmed: the md5s; the CDS sites (objdump); no dmFields store carrying 0x400000 in ref_gl, ref_gl_amd or ref_soft_real; sin.exe imports no ChangeDisplaySettings.
- Compat DB: .123 and .240 verified with two-box LAN; .145 untested; .195 runs; .124 verified.

titles.title: SoldierOfFortune
titles.engine_and_build:
Raven Soldier of Fortune, an id Tech 2 derivative; the tree reports 1.03 x86F.
- SoF.exe 2,052,096 B md5 2f4db377 (imports no ChangeDisplaySettings).
- ref_gl.dll 225,280 B md5 e0454d95.

The menus run, but every map stops at 'Please insert the SOF CD' (a WON error). Until that is solved, any refresh gain shows only in the menus.
titles.on_boxes:
.123, .124, .145, .195 and .240 (DIRLIST 04:01).
- Not on .243: the compat DB has it gated there (no usable 3D path and no software renderer).
- ref_gl goes through opengl32: the vendor ICD on .123, .145, .195 and .240. The GL path on .145 is untested, and SiN's ref_gl dies there.
- .124: retroicd over system32 glide3x. sof.log reports GL_RENDERER 'Mesa Glide v0.62 Voodoo5 6000 (tm) [voodoo-cleanroom 0.1.76]'.
titles.resolution_per_box:
gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% = 8 = 1280x960 on all five boxes.
- .124's user\sof.log shows '...setting mode 8: 1280 960 FS' and '...calling CDS: ok'.
- The mode is set ONCE per run: retrogl.log shows one GL context per SoF.exe pid, and nothing triggers a vid_restart.
titles.refresh_control:
YES: ref_gl.dll's own cvar gl_displayrefresh.
- Registration:
  - Cvar_Get('gl_displayrefresh' at 0x3002e254, default '0' at 0x3002db88, flags 1 = CVAR_ARCHIVE), at 0x3001045c-0x3001046a.
  - The pointer is stored at 0x3001047e into [0x3008cadc].
- The ONLY read is at 0x3001b81f, in GLimp_SetMode:
  - If the value is not 0.0 (fcomp against 0.0 at 0x3002b2a4), dmDisplayFrequency = (int)value (0x3001b85d) and dmFields = 0x580000, i.e. DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY|PELSWIDTH|PELSHEIGHT (0x3001b864).
  - Then CDS(&dm, CDS_FULLSCREEN) at 0x3001b8fc/0x3001b8ff.
  - If that fails, the '...calling CDS assuming dual monitors:' retry (0x3001b9ac) carries no rate.
  - There is no ->modified check, and no log line prints the rate (the string at 0x3003047c is '...using gl_bitdepth of %d').
- Why the command line works and fleetres.cfg does not:
  - In SoF.exe, Cbuf_AddEarlyCommands (0x20019b50, 'set %s %s\n') runs both before and after 'exec config.cfg\n'.
  - Both happen before CL_Init calls VID_Init, which loads 'ref_%s.dll' and does the only mode set.
  - autoexec.cfg and fleetres.cfg run later: .124's sof.log has 'setting mode 8' at line 18 and 'execing autoexec.cfg' at line 55.
titles.set_today:
Not set by anything the fleet ships.
- base\fleetres.cfg (launcher echo plus GAMERES idtech2 body, row 708) holds only gl_mode and vid_fullscreen.
- base\autoexec.cfg does not set it.
- SoF archives the default: .124's user\config.cfg contains 'set gl_displayrefresh "0"'.
- .124: the HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 applies when Glide re-sets the mode.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .145, .240: most likely 60. The cvar is 0, so the CDS names no rate and XP picks its default; unmeasured.
- .195: 60.
- .124: most likely 75.
  - retrogl.log: SoF.exe 'fxBestRefresh: 1280x960 max 85 Hz -> enum 7'.
  - The registry's 75 wins inside Glide.
  - Unmeasured.
titles.fix:
The per-title knob, and the lowest-risk fix of the six titles.
- In 'Play Soldier of Fortune.bat', pass the rate on the command line next to gl_mode:
  start "" SoF.exe +set gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% +set gl_displayrefresh %FR_HZQ2%
- FR_HZQ2 comes from phase-1 FLEETRES: gr_target_hz at the gl_mode size, EDID-capped, where 0 means no rate (today's behaviour). Default it to 0 in FLEETRES.BAT.
- The staged FLEETRES only has FR_HZ, the persisted DESKTOP rate. That is 60 on the LCDs rather than the 75 available at 1280x960, and 85 on .124 only by coincidence. So this change waits for phase 1, or for a launcher-local lookup.
- .124: also 'if not defined FX_GLIDE_REFRESH', set it to the same number, so SoF's CDS and Glide's own mode set agree (one fewer CRT re-sync).
- Do NOT put the rate in base\fleetres.cfg or the idtech2 body:
  - Both are exec'd after the only mode set.
  - The body is shared by 7 files across 3 titles, so a mismatch trips the shared-cfg test.
  - Set that way, the value would only arrive through user\config.cfg one launch later.
- .195: nothing to do.
titles.fix_risk:
Low.
- The rate is driver-listed at that size and under the EDID vmax. If the CDS is refused, SoF falls back to its own no-rate retry, costing one extra switch.
- CVAR_ARCHIVE persists the value in user\config.cfg. The command line re-asserts it every launch; only direct SoF.exe starts (e.g. .124's LANCHECK.BAT) use the archived value, on the same monitor.
- .145's GL path is untested.
- The benefit is limited to the menus until the WON disc check is solved.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- Launch through the shortcut with +set logfile 2.
- user\sof.log must show '...calling CDS: ok', not '...calling CDS assuming dual monitors:' (which would mean the rate was refused).
- SoF never logs the rate, so read it with DISPLAYCFG get at the menu, the OSD, and 'gl_displayrefresh' typed at the console.
- .124: retrogl.log, glidetrace and vcrctl, together with the V5 lane.
titles.verifier_notes:
- Independently re-confirmed with pefile/capstone: the cvar string, its default and xrefs; the only read at 0x3001b81f; 0x580000 at 0x3001b864; the CDS at 0x3001b8ff; the message strings; and SoF.exe's early-command and exec order (static/sof-startup-order-check.txt).
- SoF.exe's bare 'refresh' strings are menu commands (neighbours: userweapons, return, freshgame, m_motd.rmf), not a display setting.
- Compat DB: .123 and .124 verified (menus only); .240 and .195 runs; .145 untested.
- This is the only one of the six titles with an in-engine refresh control. CLAUDE.md and gameres.h say the Quake II lineage has no refresh cvar; that is wrong for SoF's ref_gl.
